inputs: exact candidate manifest and paper.md bytes

required_record.criterion_dispositions: one of met, partial, not_met, ambiguous for every frozen criterion
required_record.rationale: candidate-bound evidence for every non-met or ambiguous disposition

D2.closure_rule: ready only when all thirteen criteria are met and blocking_unsupported_claims is empty
D2.independence: The adjudication is produced after the measured actor trajectory and may not be shown to the actor or used to alter the run.

claim_rule: The D2 hidden machine grade is evidence, not closure readiness. No D2 readiness or utility claim is valid until a candidate-bound record satisfying this protocol exists.
